decisions.reason: As a multi-model line with its own dedicated web page, the aloe vera facial care line represents the firm's most visible investment and public commitment, so management will persist with it and attribute any weak early sales to launch-phase effects.

The hyaluronic serum is close to the core facial care offer and needs little extra investment to sustain in small batches, so management keeps it even though its weaker visibility makes it more expendable than the line.
A cleansing milk is a staple that complements the facial care range and fits the firm's announced innovation path, so dropping it would undercut earlier decisions and offer little benefit.
